stops.note: pot ashes, describing the substance leached from wood ash in pots
settled as the English word for the ash-derived alkaline substance
stops.meaning: an alkaline substance derived from wood ash

stops.note: coined by Humphry Davy with a New Latin -ium ending after isolating the element from potash
stops.meaning: the metallic element isolated from potash

current_meaning: a soft, silvery-white metallic chemical element essential to living cells
